title: project.note_pinned 0.1
description: A discrete project note's pin state changed. Identifier-only. Note bodies, link titles and URIs are user-authored and never appear in the change feed, in logs, in metrics or in error telemetry: a client learns THAT an item changed and reads the item to learn what it now says.

operationId.description: The client operation this acknowledges, so exactly one queued operation can be retired.

deleted.description: True once the item is tombstoned. The row is retained.
